name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset
description:
Provides tools for creating and assigning ChaosClothAsset clothing data to skeletal meshes.
Replicates the workflow available via the SkeletalMesh Editor viewport context menu.

tools.description:
Removes the clothing binding from a specific LOD section on the skeletal mesh.
Mirrors the SkeletalMesh Editor's "Remove Clothing Data" action.
tools.name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset.RemoveClothingFromSection

skeletalMeshPath.description: Object path to the target USkeletalMesh asset.

returnValue.description: True if a binding was found and removed.

tools.description:
Returns information about all Clothing Assets on a skeletal mesh.
Use AssetName with AssignClothingToSection.
Check bRequiresMatchingLodIndex to determine how to supply ClothingLodIndex:
  - true  (ChaosClothAsset): pass the same value as LodIndex
  - false (UClothingAssetCommon): pass any value in [0, NumClothingLods-1]
tools.name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset.ListClothingAssets

skeletalMeshPath.description: Object path to the target USkeletalMesh asset.

assetName.description: Name of the clothing asset. Pass to AssignClothingToSection.

bRequiresMatchingLodIndex.description:
If true, ClothingLodIndex passed to AssignClothingToSection must match the skeletal mesh
LodIndex. This is the case for ChaosClothAsset-derived types.
If false (UClothingAssetCommon), any value in [0, NumClothingLods-1] is valid.

numClothingLods.description:
Number of LODs available in this clothing asset.
Only relevant when bRequiresMatchingLodIndex is false.

returnValue.description: Array of clothing asset info structs.

tools.description: Returns the name of clothing bound for a specific LOD section (if any).
tools.name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset.GetSectionClothing

skeletalMeshPath.description: Object path to the target USkeletalMesh asset.

returnValue.description: The name of the clothing asset, or empty if none bound.

tools.description:
Creates a UChaosClothAssetSKMClothingAsset from a Chaos Cloth/Outfit Asset and adds it
to the skeletal mesh's clothing asset array, making it available to assign to sections.
tools.name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset.CreateClothingAsset

skeletalMeshPath.description: Object path to the target USkeletalMesh asset.

chaosClothAssetPath.description: Object path to the source UChaosClothAssetBase (cloth or outfit asset).

returnValue.description: List of created clothing assets, or empty if failed.

tools.description:
Converts a legacy UClothingAssetCommon (the cloth asset created via UChaosClothingSimulationFactory)
into a new UChaosClothAsset whose embedded Dataflow graph mirrors the legacy UChaosClothConfig and
UChaosClothSharedSimConfig values, with one WeightMap node per legacy weight map.
tools.name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset.ConvertClothingAssetCommonToChaosClothAsset

skeletalMeshPath.description: Object path to the USkeletalMesh that owns the legacy clothing asset.

clothingAssetName.description: Name of the UClothingAssetCommon on the mesh (from ListClothingAssets).

outputPackagePath.description: Folder where the new asset should be created (e.g. "/Game/Cloth/").

assetName.description: Name of the new asset; empty for default ("CA_Converted_<source>").

returnValue.description: Object path of the new UChaosClothAsset; empty on failure.

tools.description:
Binds a clothing asset to a specific LOD and section on the skeletal mesh.
Mirrors the SkeletalMesh Editor's "Apply Clothing Data" action.
Any clothing already bound to the section is unbound first.
tools.name: ChaosClothAssetToolset.ChaosClothAssetToolset.AssignClothingToSection

skeletalMeshPath.description: Object path to the target USkeletalMesh asset.

clothingAssetName.description: Name of the Clothing Asset on the mesh (e.g., from CreateClothingAsset or ListClothingAssets).

lodIndex.description: Skeletal mesh LOD index to bind to.

sectionIndex.description: Section index within the LOD to bind to.

clothingLodIndex.description: LOD index within the clothing asset to bind. For ChaosClothAsset-derived types (bRequiresMatchingLodIndex == true in ListClothingAssets), pass the same value as LodIndex. For UClothingAssetCommon, pass the desired clothing LOD (0 to NumClothingLods-1 as reported by ListClothingAssets).
